description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is an Off-Road Heavy Duty ALL METAL Door Handle Kit made for the Suzuki Samurai, SJ413 & SJ410
Lets you replace all those Weak Plastic Handles with Off-Road Grade Metal Handles.
You get the Interior Door Handles and Window Crank Handles for BOTH DOORS.
Fits All Years
EASY Installation
PLUS We Include the Pins for the Interior Handles and the Escutcheons for the Cranks!
Interior Door Handle & Window Handle Color is Chrome
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – METAL – Interior Door Handles (LH & RH) – Color: Chrome
Qty 2 – METAL – Pins for Interior Handles
Qty 2 – METAL – Window Crank Handles (LH & RH) – Color: Chrome
Qty 2 – METAL – Clips, Window Crank
Qty 2 – PLASTIC – Washers that go behind Window Cranks – Color: Black
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
